text:
mira: Quick check — thinking about adding a 'cost gating' layer at the router. Idea: if request looks like low-value (low tier, short prompt), we put it into a small decision queue (50ms window) to try cheaper region/model before immediate SLO route.

sam: Wait — is this different from probe-based hedging? seems similar.

mira: It's similar but cheaper: probes send out parallel pings to measure downstream capacity. Decision queue delays actual request briefly to let an opportunistic cheaper slot open (not parallel). Less GPU spend but adds slight added latency.

alex: Risks — queuing could add tail latency / head-of-line blocking for busy tenants. How do we avoid starving high-priority traffic?

mira: Plan: per-tenant priority bands + queue preemption. High-priority (SLA) bypasses queue. Queue size per-shard is tiny. Also add a cap: if occupancy > 20% of shard, disable gating.

lee: How about cache interference? delaying changes KV cache hit patterns.

mira: Good call. We will only gate when request key prefix is cache-safe (stateless or short-context) — heuristic in router. If not cache-safe, bypass.

nancy: Telemetry: need a sim harness to model end-to-end qps/latency/cost impact. Can we run at 1% with A/B and synthetic load?

mira: Yes — will create sim that replays traces and models queue spin-up. Also add a rollback kill-switch in routing config.

ops-bot: deploy note: feature flag "gating_v1" created in staging.

sam: Config snippet?

mira: 
```
route:
  gating: true
  gating_window_ms: 50
  per_tenant_bands: [100, 1000, 10000]
  bypass_threshold: 0.2
  cache_safe_only: true
```

alex: Sounds reasonable. Two asks: 1) add a metric for 'gated_success_rate' 2) prove no regression for 95/99 latencies in sim.

mira: Will do. I'll open an RFC follow-up with sim plan and rollout steps.

lee: +1. Also let's document expected cost delta per 100k requests.

mira: Added to follow-up. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
